title: General Processing Utilities
summary: This module provides general-purpose processing utilities, including a mixin for common processor functionalities and specific processors for multimodal inputs like ColModernVBert and GotOcr2.

nodes.label: ProcessorMixin
nodes.title: ProcessorMixin
nodes.description: Provides core functionalities for all processor classes, including saving/loading, input validation, and handling of multimodal inputs.

nodes.label: ColModernVBertProcessor
nodes.title: ColModernVBertProcessor
nodes.description: A specialized processor for ColModernVBert models, handling image and text inputs, including visual prompt prefixes and query augmentation.

nodes.label: GotOcr2Processor
nodes.title: GotOcr2Processor
nodes.description: A processor designed for GotOcr2 models, managing image and text inputs with specific handling for image tokens, bounding boxes, and multi-page documents.

nodes.label: Ernie4_5_VLMoe Processor Conversion
nodes.title: Ernie4_5_VLMoe Processor Conversion
nodes.description: Utility function to convert and save the Ernie4_5_VLMoe processor, including its tokenizer, image processor, and video processor.

nodes.label: Image Processing
nodes.title: Image Processing
nodes.description: Handles the preprocessing and transformation of image data for various models.

nodes.label: Text Processing
nodes.title: Text Processing
nodes.description: Manages the tokenization, encoding, and decoding of text data.

nodes.label: Audio Processing
nodes.title: Audio Processing
nodes.description: Manages the preprocessing and feature extraction of audio data.
